description.value: The Canadian Museum of Flight, established in 1996 at Langley Airport, preserves and displays a collection of historic Canadian aircraft and aviation artifacts. It is one of British Columbia's dedicated aviation heritage museums and a notable destination for those cycling the Fraser Valley region. Touring cyclists will find it a distinctive stop offering a look at Canada's aviation history in an airport setting.
